title: Right side view of a binary tree
storyTitle: The view from the right balcony
summary: Standing on the right balcony of each floor of a treehouse, you see only the rightmost room on that floor.
goal: List the room you see from the right on every floor

mapping.story: What you see from the right
mapping.formal: The last node of each level
List of those values, top to bottom

ladder.name: List every floor, keep the last
ladder.idea: Build the full floor-by-floor list, then take the last room of each floor.

ladder.name: Look right first, note the first room per floor
ladder.idea: Walk the tree depth-first, visiting right children before left. The first room reached at each new depth is the one seen from the right.
ladder.insight: We only need one room per floor, the first one met when looking from the right. A right-first walk meets it before any other room on that floor, so nothing else needs storing.

transfer.problem: Show the leftmost room on every floor of the treehouse instead.
transfer.explanation: Walk left-first and record the first room at each new depth, or take the first room of each level with BFS.

selfCheck: Records exactly one room per floor.
Visits the right child before the left in the depth-first version.
Detects a new floor by comparing depth with the view's length.
